evidence.expected_values: Literal independent source-derived values; checked with fractions.Fraction and half-away-from-zero rounding, not calculated by the product implementation.

notation.money: Exact signed two-decimal strings; no float comparison.
notation.fraction: A/B denotes the exact explanatory rational input. Product arithmetic must match the accepted Native numeric expressions and their operation order.
notation.hpp_amount: Sum of positive debit-side HPP vector entries within each group, then summed across groups. It is neither unit HPP nor FG delta.

source_and_concurrency_expectations.expected: Old quote refuses because complete source identity/version changed. Numeric equality is insufficient.
